sections.heading: Kharagpur: Vidyasagar Industrial Park and IIT Kharagpur
paragraphs: Kharagpur, in Paschim Medinipur district about 116 km west of Kolkata, combines a major railway junction, IIT Kharagpur and a growing industrial base. Companies with plants in and around the city include Tata Metaliks, Tata Bearings, Shyam Metaliks, Siemens, Godrej, Tata Hitachi, Ramco Cements, Grasim, Indian Oil, Keventer Agro and Mahindra & Mahindra.

The West Bengal Industrial Development Corporation is developing the Vidyasagar Industrial Park on about 1,166.64 acres at the north-east end of Kharagpur, bounded by NH 6 to the north and NH 60 towards Balasore to the east. Tata Hitachi Construction Machinery has a unit there on 250 acres, and Haldia port is about 60 km away.

sections.heading: Dairy Around Kharagpur: Keventer and the Debra Plant
paragraphs: The dairy link is direct. Keventer Agro, which sells the Metro Dairy and Keventer Milk brands, opened its ninth bulk milk collection centre inside Vidyasagar Industrial Park as part of a plan to raise processing capacity from 2.5 to 4 lakh litres a day. Bulk milk coolers and collection centres use sanitary 304L tube for milk reception and chilling lines and 316L where CIP chemistry is aggressive.

In the same district, the West Bengal government has approved a milk processing plant at Debra with a capital budget of about Rs 33 crore, covering standard milk and higher-value dairy products. We have not confirmed its construction status. A plant of that kind would need SF1 tube on most milk circuits and an electropolished SF4 bore on cultured and long-life product lines.

sections.heading: Engineering Plants, Fuel Depots and Instrument Tube
paragraphs: Steel, bearings, construction machinery and cement plants rarely need electropolished tube in their main process. Their demand is instrument and utility tube: hydraulic and lubrication lines, instrument air, cooling and DM water, and laboratory gas. Bright-annealed 316L or 304L tube to ASTM A269 with a heat-traceable 3.1 certificate covers most of it.

Where these plants run spectrometers, gas chromatographs or emission analysers, the short lines carrying high-purity argon, carrier gas or calibration gas are the exception, and an electropolished 316L bore is worth specifying there.

sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Laboratories and Research Facilities
paragraphs: IIT Kharagpur, the first of the IITs, began in May 1950 as the Eastern Higher Technical Institute, moved to its Hijli campus that September and was formally inaugurated in August 1951. Research laboratories in chemistry, materials, biotechnology and food engineering need small quantities of tube for gas manifolds, vacuum lines and purified water. For research buyers we quote short lengths in 316L, with an electropolished bore where the gas purity or contamination limit requires it, and the same certificate pack as a plant order.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Kharagpur RFQ
paragraphs: Give the service for each line (milk, CIP, laboratory gas, analyser sample, hydraulic or utility), the fluid or gas, pressure and temperature, OD and wall, quantity per size, the joining method and any surface-roughness limit. University buyers should include the tender or indent reference.

We reply with a quotation within 30 minutes. Every order ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number and PMI on every length; electropolished lots also carry our internal Ra report. Dispatch and transit to Kharagpur are confirmed in writing with each quotation.

sections.heading: Supplying Kharagpur, Haldia and the Odisha Border
paragraphs: Kharagpur Junction is the headquarters of the Kharagpur Division of South Eastern Railway. We dispatch from Mumbai and can quote several sites in south-west Bengal and north Odisha on one line list.
